catalog_uncertainty_cases.detailed_diagnosis: Retrieval was correct ('brihadeeswarar_temple'), with high cosine similarity of 0.9082. However, automatic verification was blocked because: The margin between Top-1 and Top-2 was below uncertainty_margin_threshold (0.08), or absence of EXIF GPS prevented geo-boost activation. Rule 4 classified the query as UNCERTAIN_MATCH to prevent forced attributions on competing architectural candidates.

architectural_failure_patterns.mechanism: Ancient Indian stone reliefs share visual features: weathered granite/sandstone, warm ochre tones, and repetitive iconographic friezes. When an image contains only a cropped carving rather than the macro silhouette, global CLIP ViT-B/32 lacks sufficient fine-grained class separation, causing Top-1 misretrievals.
architectural_failure_patterns.remedy_recommendation: Phase 9.0 hierarchical spatial patch routing or learned visual codebook.

architectural_failure_patterns.mechanism: Even when Top-1 retrieval is 100% accurate with similarity > 0.90, the Top-2 competitor often achieves similarity ~ 0.86-0.88. Because uncertainty_margin_threshold is fixed at 0.08, the empirical margin (0.02 - 0.05) triggers UNCERTAIN_MATCH. In the absence of EXIF GPS, geo-boost cannot bridge the gap, resulting in 0% verification recall.
architectural_failure_patterns.remedy_recommendation: Calibrate margin_threshold dynamically based on calibrated probability P(Y=1|s) >= 0.75 rather than static cosine difference.
